name: tlib
description: Shared UI and utility library for FiveM resources

ignore.tests/lua/config-validate.lua: a tlib.config VALIDATOR fixture, not a config: its `licenseKey = 'abc123'` is a synthetic input proving a declared string key validates. The config rule matches it only because the basename contains `config`. Ignored by exact path rather than by widening the rule or by allowing `licenseKey` everywhere.
ignore.tests/lua/community-configs-update.lua: a CommunityConfigsUpdate request-body fixture, not a config: its `editToken = 'tok_xyz'` is a synthetic input proving the field is forwarded in the update body, which is the whole point of the suite. The rule matches it only because the basename contains `config`. Ignored by exact path, same reasoning as config-validate.lua above — not by allowing `editToken` everywhere, which is a key that must stay caught in real config files.

scripts.secrets:control: bun run scripts/secret-gate-control.ts && SECRETS_CONTROL=1 bunx --bun --package fengari-node-cli fengari scripts/run-lua-suite.lua tests/lua/secrets-overlay.lua
scripts.setup: bun run secrets:install-hooks && bun install && cd client/web && bun install && cd ../../shared/ts && bun install
scripts.test:lua:control: bun run scripts/framerelay-control.ts && bun run scripts/runtimetxd-control.ts && bun run scripts/primitives-control.ts && CONFIG_GEN_CONTROL=1 bunx --bun --package fengari-node-cli fengari scripts/run-lua-suite.lua tests/lua/config-generation.lua
scripts.typecheck:internal: bun -e "if (!(await Bun.file('internal/shared-ts/package.json').exists())) { console.log('typecheck:internal: SKIPPED — no internal/ in this tree, which is a published clone of tLib.'); process.exit(0); } process.exit(Bun.spawnSync(['bun','run','typecheck'],{cwd:'internal/shared-ts',stdout:'inherit',stderr:'inherit'}).exitCode ?? 1)"
scripts.check:regression: bun run license:check:control && bun run license:check && bun run typecheck && bun run typecheck:shared && bun run typecheck:internal && bun run typecheck:server && bun run check:imports && bun run check:classes && bun run check:classes:control && bun run check:boolattr && bun run check:runtime-state && bun run check:runtime-state:control && bun run check:deadfiles && bun run check:deadfiles:control && bun run check:buildstamp:control && bun run check:comments && bun run check:comments:control && bun run secrets:provision:check && bun run secrets:control && bun run test && bun run test:dom && bun run test:dom:control && bun run test:lua && bun run test:lua:control
scripts.verify: bun run secrets:check && bun run lint && bun run check:regression && bun run build
